what: Online track finder for the PSI piM1 spectrometer: momentum map, channel table, one-track light, finder constants. Same format and finder as 19_DAQ_update/handoff.
readout_note: winner-takes-all inside a cluster: a reading's channel is its largest-light channel. Channels 1-based.
map_note: exported: rows with n_cal >= 5 (finder.map_min_n; online_finder.load applies the same cut). ok = 1 when n_cal >= 15 (sigma measured from enough calibration tracks). Built at field_T: a different field needs a new map.
map_calibration: 1,000,000 pi- flat in 100-500 MeV/c with the piM1 spot and divergence, through g4beamline (STEP field map, iron, air, decays, scattering), then the detector model with fluctuating light along the path at the track's angle, at the threshold below (design/online_map/build_online_map.py, as 19 build_map.py); simulation, to be replaced by beam calibration
pattern_note: channels per gang width [1, 2, 4, 8 bars]; channel 1 = bar 0 (the 1-bar channels first)
planes_note: distance along the beam from the pipe exit to each plane's strip centre (the finder uses the differences for its time test); T1/T2 move between settings sideways only
gate_note: PLACEHOLDER (19's value): a channel's hit counts when its measured time is within +-10 ns of its clock-expected arrival at that plane (applied before the finder)

finder.sigma_t_note: per-channel time resolution by gang width; PLACEHOLDER = rise time / 4 (19, user 2026-09-30)

counters.gas_cherenkov: one bit per bunch; fired on an accepted bunch -> status electron
